text:
eva_partnerops: Quick sync — we're starting a small IAAS RefKit for CloudPartnerX (reference architectures + Terraform modules + example app). Goal: make it easy for partners to deploy Redwood inference on their infra. Who can lead the module layout?

mika_cloud: I can take lead on module layout. initial thought: mono-repo with clear module boundaries. rough structure: 
```
/modules/
  network/
  compute/
  gpu/
  storage/
  monitoring/
/examples/
  simple-llm-app/
  high-throughput-pipeline/
/docs/
  architecture.md
  deployment-guides/
```

keep examples minimal but end-to-end.

sam_engineer: +1. couple constraints: modules should accept an `accelerator_profile` var (e.g. a2-ampere, g5, etc) and expose outputs for `instance_ids` and `kube_node_labels`. also prefer using provider aliasing for multi-region support.

jordan_rm: Timeline ask from partner: they'd like a draft by next Wed for an internal demo. can we commit to a week sprint? also we should plan a partner-ready slide + checklist for the announcement.

eva_partnerops: @mika_cloud can you sketch the module API surface by EOD today? we'll need that to start docs and tests. jordan: I'll own the partner slide deck.

anya_docs: I can stub out architecture.md and a diagram. for docs: we should include an operational checklist (SLA expectations, secrets/KMS notes, logging/telemetry pointers). please drop sample TF skeleton so i can link vars to docs.

mika_cloud: putting skeleton here — lightweight example for a GPU module and top-level usage:
```hcl
// modules/gpu/main.tf
variable "accelerator_profile" { type = string }
variable "instance_count" { type = number, default = 1 }
resource "aws_instance" "gpu" {
  ami           = var.ami
  instance_type = var.accelerator_profile
  count         = var.instance_count
  tags = { Name = "redwood-gpu" }
}
output "gpu_instance_ids" { value = aws_instance.gpu.*.id }
```

// root usage example
```hcl
module "gpu" {
  source = "../modules/gpu"
  accelerator_profile = var.accelerator_profile
  instance_count = 2
}
```

sam_engineer: For CI: recommend terraform validate + tflint + `terragrunt` smoke in GH Actions. add a lightweight `plan` test using a small profile. i can add GH Actions jobs.

repo-bot: New draft branch created: `refkit/cloudpartnerx/layout` — PR: https://git.internal/redwood/refkit/pull/42 (CI pending)

mika_cloud: will add module-level README and examples. also propose a `compat.yaml` listing supported instance families per cloud region. that helps partners pick profiles.

eva_partnerops: Action items: 1) @mika_cloud = module API + compat.yaml (due EOD today); 2) @sam_engineer = CI pipeline + smoke tests (due Tue); 3) @anya_docs = draft architecture.md + checklist (due Tue). jordan_rm will prep partner deck for demo.

jordan_rm: I'll coordinate a dry-run demo Thurs. putting calendar invite after we have the sample deployed.

anya_docs: small doc note — include KMS example snippet and a short section on audit logging config (where to send logs, retention). i'll draft that into `/docs/deployment-guides/security.md`.

eva_partnerops: awesome. if we can get the basic example app (simple-llm-app) deployable by next Wed, partner demo should be doable. small ask: label all resources with `team=partnerships` so infra cost tracking is easier.

mika_cloud: will add tags and `tfvars.example`. :thumbsup:

sam_engineer: i'll queue the GH Actions PR after the module README is in. quick Q: do we want to support both k8s (eks/gke) and straight VM deploys in v1 or pick one?

eva_partnerops: let's focus v1 on VM-based reference (faster to validate with partners). follow-up v2 will add k8s patterns.

mika_cloud: noted. starting work now. will ping in the thread when PRs are up.

eva_partnerops: Thanks all — good start. I'll post partner briefing once the branch is stable. :sparkles:
